message.content: According to the conversation, Li Hua enjoys the strategy involved in the game, particularly the planning of approaches and teamwork. Additionally, he finds the adrenaline rush during the final circle of the battle royale mode to be unbeatable. Li Hua also mentioned that he loves the "epic wins" and found memorable victories, such as one where he and his team managed to outsmart the last team and secure a win in the final circle.
